source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return out
    width = len(grid[0])
    top_colors = {v for v in grid[0] if v not in (0, 2)}
    if not top_colors:
        return out
    color = next(iter(top_colors))
    top_cols = {c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == color}
    bottom_cols = {c for row in grid[divider + 1:] for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color}
    bridge_cols = top_cols & bottom_cols
    for r in range(1, divider):
        for c in bridge_cols:
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
